title: Castle War
info: Bring full march, preset #2, and be online 15 minutes earlier.

title: bear 1
info:
🐻 BEAR EVENT RULES 🚨

⚠️ Don’t forget to use pet skills!

🔥 1. STARTING RALLIES
• Use best heroes + best gear

Infantry: Amadeus, Helga, Zoe
Cavalry: Petra, Jabel
Archers: Rosa, Vivian, Marlin

❗ Rally Capacity must be at least 1M
⏰ All players must start a rally at minute 23

🤝 2. JOINING RALLIES

• For each rally, the first hero (captain / left slot) must be:

🟢 S-Tier (BEST Damage)
Chenko, Amadeus, Yeonwoo, Amane, Margot, Vivian
→ + any 2 other heroes

🟡 A-Tier (OK)
Hilde, Thrud
→ + any 2 other heroes

🔴 B-Tier (AVOID if above 2⭐)
Marlin, Petra, Rosa

❌ DO NOT USE
• Any blue heroes
• Any heroes not listed above

📌 If all S-Tier and A-Tier heroes are already used:
→ Use low-star gold heroes (under 2⭐)
OR
→ Join with troops only (no heroes)

⚔️ TROOP FORMATION

➡️ Standard players:
5% Infantry / 25% Cavalry / 70% Archers

➡️ Advanced players:
5% Infantry / 10–15% Cavalry / 80%+ Archers

💣 IMPORTANT
Repeated mistakes after being warned → REMOVAL from the alliance during the event
